content:
maya: kicking off a config-only change to tighten per-route limits and nudge batching after the latency tail we saw at 18:14.
deploy-bot: started deploy 1777777999 -> config-only canary 10% (us-west-2) by maya
vince: window?
maya: mid-shift now is fine, canary for 30m then ramp if metrics look good. ops ok?
raj: quick check — which params are changing exactly?
maya: short snippet:
```yaml
routes:
  api.default:
    max_concurrent_requests: 64
    request_timeout_ms: 8000
    batch_window_ms: 12
    queue_depth: 48
    routing_policy: prefer-low-latency
canary:
  pct: 10
  region: us-west-2
  fallbacks:
    - pinned_version: v2025-09-02
```
lina: noted the timeout bump from 5s -> 8s. that should reduce retries spamming fallback.
vince: any KV cache/seq changes? last time small batch_window blew up kvcache pressure.
maya: no model or code changes, only batching + queue_depth and per-route concurrency. we added extra kvcache backpressure check in the runtime gating rule.
raj: ok. what are the rollback criteria?
maya: 
- 5%+ error rate (5xx) above baseline for >5m
- p95 latency > baseline + 200ms for >10m
- kvcache eviction rate increase >2x for >5m
- customer-facing errors in SLO routes
lina: can deploy-bot add observability alerts to the canary: p50/p95/p99, 5xx-count, kvcache-evictions
deploy-bot: observability hooks attached: group=canary-1777777999 metrics stream -> #infra-telemetry
sre-oncall: I'll watch dashboards and CPU/GPU host queues. ping if we need to pin traffic back to pinned_version.
vince: also add a quick release note blurb and changelog line; product uses that to message customers.
maya: draft: "Config-only: increased request timeout to 8s, tightened per-route concurrency and reduced batching window to lower tokenization tail latency. Canary 10% in us-west-2. No model changes."
raj: minor nit — include fallback pinned_version id.
maya: updated: "... fallback pinned_version v2025-09-02"
deploy-bot: canary promoted to 25% at 1777778030 (automated ramp, metrics within thresholds)
lina: seeing slight p95 improvement on gen routes. kvcache evictions stable.
vince: good. keep ramping slowly if stable.
deploy-bot: canary ramp to 50% at 1777778055 (manual approval by maya)
sre-oncall: no anomalies on infra side, tracking traces for long-tail requests.
maya: decision: continue to 100% after 1h if no regressions. otherwise rollback to pinned_version.
vince: please add the following to release notes section in the internal release doc: "Impact: small latency improvement for typical interactive requests; admin teams may see higher per-request duration for very large prompts but fewer timeouts."
raj: tagging ops for a brief readme update on recommended batching params for self-hosted customers.
lina: ops acked. I'll run the post-deploy smoke check in 15m.
deploy-bot: deploy complete: 100% at 1777778075. rollout strategy: canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%.
maya: thanks all. leaving monitoring for next 60m then will close this thread and add final release-note link.
vince: :thumbsup:
raj: :+1:
sre-oncall: standing by, will open incident if thresholds breach.
